disposition: A user-requested SPECTRUM adaptation of established spectral coefficient fitting and distribution-constrained optimization ideas; no originality/priority claim. Candidate implementation remains conditional on independent math/selection review.

sources.name: SPECTRUM current native code
sources.provenance: Direct read and retained complete source snapshot in this task.
facts: collect_covariances uses per-example selected-completion mean NLL, accumulates G.T@G at all nonpadding projection positions and divides by token count.
Current spectral_soft uses 1/(1+tau*(1-lambda/lambda_max)); adaptive uses tau*(H_r/H_1)^gamma, default gamma=5.
Calibration is reestimated each round by default on fixed reference tasks; current default max_examples is 50.
Folding performs float32 T.T@W then casts to parameter dtype and restores original tensors.
Current standard training uses model(**batch).loss; fixed_anchor_replay is a separate optional existing control and is excluded from this new arm.
sources.delta: Replace only generation operator selection with empirical reference-loss/KL constrained full-spectrum gain fitting; ordinary recursive SFT unchanged.

sources.provenance: Parent and prior agents read PMLR full text; math author inspected the retained extracted text in this session.
facts: Uses spectral analysis of token hidden-state loss gradients and selection of supervised long-CoT steps.
